source_title: Eastman Eagle S3L Laser Cutting System Service Manual

Asset.name: Eastman Eagle S3L Laser Cutting System
Asset.description: Automatic laser cutting system covered by the service manual.

Component.name: Stop Discs
Component.description: Stop discs in the pause circuit.

Component.name: Tool And Layer Mapping
Component.description: Software mapping between layers, tools, and tool holders.

Component.name: Fume Extractor Control Panel
Component.description: Control panel used to adjust fume extractor vacuum pressure.

Component.name: Vacuum Filters
Component.description: Vacuum filters in the laser fume extractor.

Component.name: Vacuum Hose And Funnel
Component.description: Vacuum hose and funnel for laser fume extraction.

Component.name: Brass Laser Nozzle
Component.description: Brass laser nozzle at the laser beam outlet.

Component.name: Beam Deflecting Mirrors
Component.description: Mirrors that deflect the laser beam.

Symptom.name: UIT Does Not Power Up
Symptom.description: The UIT does not power. Screen is blank and not lit up.

Symptom.name: Machine Stop during Cut Due to Unintentional pause
Symptom.description: The machine stops in middle of cut and displays message Machine Paused.

Symptom.name: The buttons on the Touch Screen are out of alignment
Symptom.description: The touch screen buttons do not match where the screen needs to be touched.

Symptom.name: The Cutting Tool or Pen does not move down
Symptom.description: The tool or Pen does not move down when cutting a file.

Symptom.name: Laser Fume Extractor has reduced vacuum or no vacuum
Symptom.description: An odor is present when cutting with the laser tool or Laser cutting path is wider than normal.

Symptom.name: Laser cutting path is too wide
Symptom.description: The laser cutting path increases to an undesirable width.

Symptom.name: Loss of laser cutting power
Symptom.description: The laser cutting power decreases causing non-cut edges.

FailureMode.name: Intermittent pause circuit, usually in the stop discs
FailureMode.description: The cut interruption is typically caused by an intermittent pause circuit, usually in the stop discs.

FailureMode.name: Touch screen calibration is required
FailureMode.description: Touch screen calibration is required when buttons are out of alignment.

FailureMode.name: Layer is not mapped to a tool or the tool is not on the tool holder
FailureMode.description: The layer is not mapped to a tool or the tool is not on the tool holder.

FailureMode.name: Brass laser nozzle bent
FailureMode.description: The tube or nozzle is bent, so the laser beam reflects off the inside wall of the nozzle causing a wide path.

FailureMode.name: Vacuum filters require replacement
FailureMode.description: The fume extractor vacuum filters require replacement.

FailureMode.name: Vacuum hose and funnel require cleaning
FailureMode.description: The vacuum hose and funnel require cleaning.

FailureMode.name: Damage to brass laser nozzle
FailureMode.description: Damage to brass laser nozzle can make the cutting path too wide.

FailureMode.name: Damaged or dirty lens
FailureMode.description: The focusing lens is damaged or dirty.

FailureMode.name: Damage, burn mark or dirt on the beam deflecting mirrors
FailureMode.description: The beam deflecting mirrors have damage, burn mark or dirt.

FailureMode.name: Damage or debris in laser nozzle
FailureMode.description: Damage or debris in laser nozzle reduces cutting power.

FailureMode.name: Beam mirrors out of adjustment
FailureMode.description: The mirrors may need to be adjusted, widening the laser cutting path.

CorrectiveAction.name: Tighten the plunger to increase activation pressure
CorrectiveAction.description: Tighten the plunger to increase activation pressure and loosen to decrease activation pressure.
CorrectiveAction.instruction_text: Tighten the plunger to increase activation pressure and loosen to decrease activation pressure.
CorrectiveAction.source_title: Eastman Eagle S3L Laser Cutting System Service Manual

CorrectiveAction.name: Select save and exit to complete calibration
CorrectiveAction.description: Navigate to screen page 3 and select save and exit to complete calibration.
CorrectiveAction.instruction_text: Calibrate the touch screen. Select save and exit to complete calibration.
CorrectiveAction.source_title: Eastman Eagle S3L Laser Cutting System Service Manual

CorrectiveAction.name: Click and drag the tool to the spindle or the layer to the tool
CorrectiveAction.description: Click and drag the tool to the spindle or the layer to the tool before sending the file to the cutter.
CorrectiveAction.instruction_text: Adjust the tool and layer mapping. Click and drag the tool to the spindle or the layer to the tool before sending the file to the cutter.
CorrectiveAction.source_title: Eastman Eagle S3L Laser Cutting System Service Manual

CorrectiveAction.name: Adjust the mirrors
CorrectiveAction.description: Adjust the mirrors when the laser cutting path is too wide.
CorrectiveAction.source_title: Eastman Eagle S3L Laser Cutting System Service Manual

CorrectiveAction.name: Replace vacuum filters
CorrectiveAction.source_title: Eastman Eagle S3L Laser Cutting System Service Manual

CorrectiveAction.name: Clean vacuum hose and funnel
CorrectiveAction.source_title: Eastman Eagle S3L Laser Cutting System Service Manual

CorrectiveAction.name: Replace nozzle if any damage is present
CorrectiveAction.description: Replace nozzle if any damage is present.
CorrectiveAction.instruction_text: Replace nozzle if any damage is present.
